class.name: NNBTPassBy
class.brief_description: Runs an optional [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] hook and always returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS].
class.description: Use as a lightweight side-effect step inside an [NNBTSequence] (such as updating a blackboard key or playing a sound) without needing to return a status or wrap a child node. Note that inside an [NNBTSelector], returning [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] stops the selector immediately. To wrap a child node instead, use [NNBTPassThrough].
